verdict: AVGO beat Q2 revenue/EPS/AI chips but stock slid ~14% AH as Q3 AI guide ($16B) missed $17.2B est. and FY2027 target held at $100B — beat-and-fade
body_md:
## AVGO earnings reaction (reported Jun 3 AMC)

### 1. Actual Results vs. Expectations

Broadcom's Q2 FY2026 print beat headline revenue and EPS but missed on software revenue, while AI chips came in just above guidance.

| Metric | Actual | Consensus | Beat / Miss |
|--------|--------|-----------|-------------|
| Revenue | **$22.19B** | ~$22.1B | +$70M (+0.3%) beat |
| Non-GAAP EPS | **$2.44** | ~$2.40 | +$0.04 beat |
| AI semiconductor revenue | **$10.8B** | $10.7B (co. guide) | Slight beat; +143% YoY |
| Infrastructure software | **$7.18B** | ~$7.32B | Miss ~$140M |

> Note: The user-supplied Q2 consensus of ~$22.9B is above the prevailing Wall St. number (~$22.1B); multiple post-print sources cite a narrow revenue beat against the lower figure. If measured vs. $22.9B the quarter was a ~$710M miss — the difference is attributable to estimate vintage/sourcing.

Net income surged **+88% YoY**; free cash flow hit **$10.3B** (46% of revenue). Revenue up 48% YoY overall.

*Sources: [Alphastreet](https://news.alphastreet.com/broadcom-q2-2026-revenue-hits-22-19b-up-48-year-over-year/) · [TechTimes](https://www.techtimes.com/articles/317703/20260603/broadcom-earnings-record-ai-revenue-hits-108b-stock-slips-software-miss.htm) · [GuruFocus/Investing.com](https://ca.investing.com/news/company-news/broadcom-inc-avgo-q2-2026-earnings-call-highlights-record-revenue-driven-by-ai-semiconductor--4675065)*

---

### 2. Guidance

**Q3 FY2026 guidance issued June 3:**

| Segment | Q3 Guide | YoY Growth |
|---------|----------|------------|
| Total revenue | **$29.4B** | +84% |
| Semiconductor (total) | $20.5B | +124% |
| — of which AI chips | **$16.0B** | +200%+ |
| Infrastructure software | $8.9B | +31% |
| Non-GAAP op. margin | ~67% | — |

**Key guide miss:** Q3 AI chip revenue of **$16.0B vs. analyst estimate ~$17.2B** — a $1.2B shortfall that was the primary selloff catalyst.

**FY2027 AI target not raised:** Management reiterated ">$100 billion" in AI revenue for FY2027 rather than upgrading — the bull case had baked in a raise.

**Backlog / bookings commentary:** Management cited "multi-year contracts" with major hyperscaler customers supporting visibility but gave no specific backlog dollar figure on the call.

*Sources: [SeekingAlpha](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4600500-broadcom-outlines-29_4b-q3-revenue-outlook-driven-by-16b-ai-semiconductor-revenue) · [StockTitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/news/AVGO/broadcom-inc-announces-second-quarter-fiscal-year-2026-financial-if4yrbje8hq6.html) · [Yahoo Finance / CNBC](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/broadcom-stock-sinks-in-after-hours-as-ai-chip-forecast-disappoints-165602504.html)*

---

### 3. Stock Reaction — Beat-and-Fade

| Session | Move | Approx. Price |
|---------|------|---------------|
| Pre-earnings close (Jun 3) | — | ~$479–$482 |
| After-hours Jun 3 (AMC) | **-14% to -16%** | ~$410–$413 |
| Pre-market Jun 4 | -12% to -15% | ~$410–$415 |
| Jun 4 intraday range | — | $403–$479 |

A textbook **beat-and-fade / sell-the-news** reaction. Despite beating headline revenue and EPS, AVGO shed ~14–16% after hours as the Q3 AI guide disappointed and FY2027 guidance wasn't lifted. Macro headwinds (Iran war concerns weighed on the broader market June 4) amplified the move. AMD and Intel were also dragged lower in sympathy. The stock had front-run the report, leaving little margin for a guide miss.

*Sources: [247 Wall St.](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/06/04/broadcom-sinks-14-on-soft-ai-chip-outlook-despite-earnings-beat-dragging-down-amd-and-intel/) · [TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/261944759-avgo-q2-earnings-broadcom-outlook-investors-ai-stock-after-tradingkey) · [IndMoney](https://www.indmoney.com/blog/us-stocks/why-avgo-stock-is-falling-after-broadcom-q2-fy2026-earnings)*

---

| Firm | Analyst | Old PT | New PT | Rating |
|------|---------|--------|--------|--------|
| Jefferies | Blayne Curtis | $500 | **$550** | Buy |

| DA Davidson | — | $375 | **$400** | Neutral |

**Pre-earnings context** (for reference — raised before the print):

| Firm | Old PT | New PT | Rating |
|------|--------|--------|--------|
| Morgan Stanley | $470 | $485 | Overweight |
| Susquehanna | $450 | $490 | Positive |
| UBS | $475 | $490 | Buy |
| Citi | — | $500 | — |

Post-earnings raises from Jefferies ($550) and Deutsche Bank ($515) suggest the sell-side views the AH selloff as an overreaction; the neutral camp (DA Davidson $400) sees limited upside from current levels.

*Sources: [Benzinga / Wall St. Forecasters](https://www.benzinga.com/analyst-stock-ratings/analyst-color/26/06/52962219/top-wall-street-forecasters-revamp-broadcom-price-target-ahead-of-q2-earnings) · [GuruFocus / Morgan Stanley note](https://www.gurufocus.com/news/8893579/avgo-maintained-by-morgan-stanley-price-target-raised-to-485)*

---

### 5. Net Read

The print **confirms** Broadcom's AI-infrastructure thesis at the revenue level — 143% YoY AI chip growth and a $16B Q3 AI target are undeniably strong — but the failure to beat the $17.2B AI guide expectation and the refusal to raise the FY2027 "$100B+" target challenged the "growth-rate acceleration" narrative baked into a stock that had been pricing perfection, making this a **prove-it-again quarter** rather than a re-rating catalyst.
